Callout.Name: Suspected Drug House
Callout.Message: High foot traffic through a house at all hours.
Callout.Advisory: Multiple visitors, brief stays, neighbours keep reporting it.

Script.Line: It is a shared house. People come and go from a shared house.
I rent a room. I do not know what the others get up to.
You need a warrant for the rest of it, and I know my rights on that.

Lines.Approach: Same house, same thing, four times this month. The neighbours have had enough.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
